attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"went quiet last night","reason":"The briefing gives no timing for Quell's disappearance."},{"span":"Rumor says he was heading to Lowmere","reason":"The briefing never links Quell to Lowmere."},{"span":"I've halted all dispatches to that settlement","reason":"The briefing says the Rim Dispatch stopped sending reporters; it does not say Ilse did."},{"span":"burned another ferry","reason":"Implies an earlier ferry burning that the briefing does not mention."},{"span":"Three settlements report smoke rising over the water","reason":"Invented reports; reuses the raiders' settlement count as a number of witnesses."},{"span":"locals say they fled for their lives before the boats caught fire","reason":"Invented eyewitness event."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin piles invented detail onto the briefing: timing, a Lowmere link, three witnessing settlements and fleeing locals. It also breaks the format with a radio-style 'stay tuned' sign-off and a word-count note. The voice is generic and melodramatic ('deafening' silence) rather than dry and wry."}
